title: In Praise of Meditation
html:
Find a quiet moment.

Step away from the noise, the pressure, the constant pull of your screen. Give yourself space to think.

Because only when you stop do you start to see clearly.

When you take time to reflect on where you are and where you want to be, the important things begin to stand out. Meditation is simply this - the sound of silence, allowing your mind to settle. Calm.

Do it because you want to understand yourself.

This is scary for some, and they will do anything to avoid it. Like staying busy, busy, busy.

Do it, not because it is fashionable. Not because others say you should.

Yet, in that quiet space, you begin to see things as they are. Not just how they feel in the moment, but how they shape your future.

The challenges in your life will not stop. But you can stop them from disturbing your inner calm.

It is like standing on a mountain, watching storms move across the land below. The storms are still there, but they no longer control you - you’re above them.

You don’t reach that mountain top in one leap, though. You get there in stages.

The small annoyances of daily life are your training.

With calmness, you observe them come and go. You cannot avoid them, but you can decide whether they disturb you.

When you take time to quiet your mind, you begin to take control of thoughts that have no right to command you.

And in that, you create meaning.

This week’s Motivator

You cannot stop life’s storms, but you can stop them from reaching your inner self. TheMagic Pause helps with this.

Prompt for the week

When will I take time to sit in silence and think about what truly matters? Make time, do it.
